headline: GOGOLOOK Financial Report / Q2 Profit Hits Record NT$59.61 Million, EPS NT$1.69
summary: Trust technology provider GOGOLOOK reported record revenue and profit for Q2 2026, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching NT$59.61 million. Operating efficiency improved after crossing critical mass.
why: GOGOLOOK is a Taiwan-listed fintech services provider, and its results offer a read on demand for trust technology services.
